name: Shooter
tooltip:
Shooter
A reliable all-rounder.
Hits one enemy at a time.
Medium range and damage.

name: Slime
tooltip:
Slime
Slows enemies down.
Hits several enemies at once.
Deals no damage.

name: Bomber
tooltip:
Bomber
Explodes on the first hit.
Heavy damage to all
enemies nearby.

name: Booster
tooltip:
Booster
Doesn't attack enemies.
Shoots your towers instead
and boosts them.

name: Sniper
tooltip:
Sniper
Extreme range.
Very high damage to one enemy.
Slow to reload.

name: Mage
tooltip:
Mage
An imaginary tower.
Fades in and out and only
attacks while visible.
Huge range, area damage.
Expensive.
